name: Hadriacus Palus: human Exploration Zone
slopeNote: slope.png = max slope (deg x 4) inside each cell; pass it to planMission as fineSlope

base.name: Palus landing zone
base.why: A flat stretch of the palus plain, picked by us on the 1 m DEM. Skinner et al. 2015 (Exploration Zone workshop, #1052) proposed this plain for a human landing

about.blurb: Hadriacus Palus was proposed in 2015 as a place for the first human crew: a flat, safe plain next to the Hadriacus Cavi, depressions more than 800 m deep that expose layered rock no rover has visited.

credits: Pipeline adapted from Sol Atlas by The SOL Explorers. Data: NASA / JPL / USGS / ESA.
